description: Securing workloads and data in public and hybrid clouds: the shared responsibility model, identity and access management, network security, encryption and key management, logging and threat detection, securing containers and serverless functions, and compliance including data residency under Ghana's Data Protection Act 843. Practised by attacking and hardening deliberately misconfigured environments in a simulated cloud console and terminal in the browser, taught to the depth of the professional cloud security certifications.
modelledOn: Cloud Security Alliance, Security Guidance for Critical Areas of Focus in Cloud Computing and the CCSK body of knowledge
NIST SP 800-144 Guidelines on Security and Privacy in Public Cloud Computing and NIST SP 800-53 controls
(ISC)2 Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) and AWS Certified Security - Specialty objectives
outcomes: Apply the shared responsibility model to IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and serverless services and model threats to a cloud architecture.
Design identity and access policies with least privilege, federation and short-lived credentials, and find privilege escalation paths.
Secure cloud networks with segmentation, private endpoints, firewalls and protection against denial of service.
Protect data with encryption at rest and in transit, managed keys, secrets management and backup strategies.
Build logging, monitoring and detection pipelines and respond to cloud security incidents.
Assess compliance with data protection law and standards and secure container and serverless workloads end to end.

units.title: The shared responsibility model
topics: Who secures what in IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and serverless; where customers most often fail
The cloud threat landscape: misconfiguration, credential theft, insecure APIs, account hijacking, insider threats
Case studies of public storage bucket leaks and leaked access keys in source repositories
Threat modelling a cloud application with STRIDE and attack trees; the MITRE ATT&CK cloud matrix

units.title: Identity and access management
topics: Principals, roles, policies and permissions; policy evaluation logic and explicit denies
Least privilege in practice: permission boundaries, service control policies, access analysers
Federation and single sign-on with SAML and OpenID Connect; MFA and phishing-resistant authenticators
Workload identity: instance roles, Kubernetes service accounts, OIDC federation for CI pipelines; eliminating long-lived keys
Privilege escalation paths in cloud IAM and how to find them; break-glass accounts

units.title: Network security in the cloud
topics: Virtual networks, subnets and route tables; security groups versus network ACLs
Private endpoints, service endpoints, NAT and egress control; removing public exposure
Bastions, session managers and zero-trust access in place of open SSH and RDP
Web application firewalls, DDoS protection and API rate limiting
Hybrid connectivity: site-to-site VPN and dedicated links; flow logs for network forensics

units.title: Data protection and encryption
topics: Data classification and discovery; tokenisation and masking of personal and payment data
Encryption at rest: provider-managed, customer-managed and customer-supplied keys; envelope encryption with AES-256
Key management services and hardware security modules; key rotation and separation of duties
Encryption in transit: TLS configuration, certificate management, mutual TLS between services
Secrets management with vaults; backups, immutable storage and ransomware resilience

units.title: Logging, monitoring and detection
topics: Audit logs, data access logs and flow logs; centralising logs and protecting them from tampering
Cloud security posture management: benchmarks such as the CIS Foundations Benchmarks and continuous misconfiguration scanning
Threat detection services and SIEM integration; writing detection rules for suspicious API activity
Cloud incident response: containment by revoking credentials, snapshotting for forensics, recovery
Investigating a simulated breach that begins with a leaked key and ends in data exfiltration

units.title: Securing containers and serverless
topics: Container supply chain: image scanning, signing, software bills of materials, trusted registries
Kubernetes security: RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies, admission control, runtime detection
Serverless risks: over-privileged functions, event injection, dependency vulnerabilities, denial of wallet
Securing APIs and gateways: authentication, authorisation, input validation against the OWASP API Security Top 10
Infrastructure as code scanning and policy as code to stop insecure deployments before they happen

units.title: Compliance and data residency
topics: Ghana's Data Protection Act 843: principles, registration with the Data Protection Commission, cross-border transfer of personal data
Ghana's Cybersecurity Act 1038 and the licensing of service providers; sector rules from the Bank of Ghana for financial data
Data residency and sovereignty: choosing regions, local and in-country hosting, contractual safeguards
Frameworks and assurance: ISO/IEC 27001, 27017 and 27018, SOC 2, PCI DSS for payment card data, CSA Cloud Controls Matrix
Evidence collection, continuous compliance and preparing for an audit

units.title: Cloud security architecture capstone
topics: Secure landing zones: account and subscription structure, guardrails, centralised logging and identity
Security reviews against well-architected security pillars
Multi-cloud and hybrid security: consistent identity, policy and logging across providers and on-premises data centres
Capstone: secure a mobile money style payment platform in the cloud, with a threat model, hardened configuration, detection rules and a compliance report

schedule.title: Shared responsibility and cloud threats
schedule.exercise: Draw a responsibility table for IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and serverless, then write a STRIDE threat list for a small clinic appointment app.

tasks.title: Find and fix a publicly readable storage bucket in a sample account, then confirm an anonymous request is now denied
Draw an architecture diagram of a three-tier web app and annotate it with at least eight STRIDE threats and one mitigation each
Work through a case in which a leaked access key is found in a repository, choose investigation steps and score the response against a rubric

schedule.title: Identity and access management basics
schedule.exercise: Evaluate three sample policies by hand with an allow, a deny and an implicit deny, and state the final decision for each request.

tasks.title: Create a read-only role for one bucket, attach it to a test user and confirm that reads succeed and writes are denied
Tighten an over-broad wildcard policy to least privilege using the access analyser findings, and verify the three required actions still work
Set up federated sign-in with enforced multi-factor authentication for an admin group, then test that a session without the second factor is blocked

schedule.title: Workload identity and escalation paths
schedule.exercise: List five IAM permissions that can lead to privilege escalation and explain the chain of calls an attacker would use for one of them.

tasks.title: Replace a long-lived access key in a function's configuration with an attached instance role and confirm the function still reads its bucket
Review a set of five roles, identify the one allowing policy attachment that enables escalation, and remove the dangerous permission safely
Trace a three-step escalation path from a low-privilege developer to administrator in a seeded account, then break the path at the cheapest point and document why

schedule.title: Virtual networks and private access
schedule.exercise: Explain in writing the difference between a stateful security group and a stateless network ACL, using one return-traffic example.

tasks.title: Build a virtual network with a public and a private subnet and security groups allowing only HTTPS from the internet to the web tier
Remove the public IP from a database server, add a private endpoint and NAT for updates, and verify only the app tier can connect
Replace open SSH access to servers with a bastion host behind a restrictive ACL on the topology and prove other external hosts cannot reach them

schedule.title: Perimeter defence and hybrid links
schedule.exercise: Write rate-limit and WAF rule ideas for a public payment API, with the attack each rule is meant to stop.

tasks.title: Attach a web application firewall rule blocking a SQL injection pattern to a load balancer and confirm a crafted request is rejected
Build a site-to-site tunnel between a branch and a data centre in the simulator and verify encrypted traffic reaches the private server
Read a day of flow logs from a seeded account, identify the host scanning internal ports and the one exfiltrating data, and write the blocking rules

schedule.title: Data protection and encryption keys
schedule.exercise: Classify twelve fields of a patient record by sensitivity and choose masking, tokenisation or encryption for each with a reason.

tasks.title: Turn on customer-managed key encryption for a storage bucket and confirm an unauthorised principal cannot decrypt an uploaded object
Create a key with a rotation schedule and separate key administrator and key user roles, then test that neither role can do the other's job
Implement envelope encryption of a file with a data key wrapped by a master key, then re-wrap after rotation and verify decryption still works

schedule.title: Transit security, secrets and backups
schedule.exercise: List what must be backed up, where, and how it is protected from deletion, for a mobile money payments database facing ransomware.

tasks.title: Attach a certificate to a load balancer, redirect HTTP to HTTPS and reject TLS versions below 1.2, then verify with test requests
Move a database password from environment variables into a secrets vault, grant access to one role and confirm the application still starts
Design immutable cross-region backups with retention locks and then simulate a ransomware deletion attempt to prove recovery within the stated RPO

schedule.title: Logging, posture and detection
schedule.exercise: Pick five controls from a benchmark, say how each would be checked automatically, and describe one alert you would not want to be noisy.

tasks.title: Enable audit logging in all regions, send logs to a locked-down bucket and confirm a deleted log object cannot be removed by the admin
Run a posture scan against a seeded account, triage 15 findings by severity and fix the five that expose data to the internet
Write detection rules for root login, disabled logging and unusual key use, then test them against replayed activity and report false positives

schedule.title: Incident response in the cloud
schedule.exercise: Write a one-page runbook for a leaked access key covering containment, evidence preservation and recovery steps in order.

tasks.title: Revoke a compromised access key, snapshot the affected server's disk for forensics and isolate the instance with a quarantine security group
Respond to a branching ransomware scenario by choosing containment and communication steps and score the decisions against a response rubric
Investigate a simulated breach from audit logs, build a timeline from key leak to data exfiltration, and state what data was taken

schedule.title: Containers and serverless security
schedule.exercise: Review a short Kubernetes manifest and list every setting that violates a restricted pod standard, with the fix for each.

tasks.title: Scan a container image with a vulnerability tool, list critical findings and rebuild from a patched base image until none remain
Create a role binding granting one service account read access to one namespace and a network policy that denies all other pod traffic
Reduce an over-privileged serverless function to the least permissions it needs and add a concurrency cap to defend against denial of wallet

schedule.title: API and pipeline security
schedule.exercise: Apply the OWASP API Top 10 to a mobile money wallet API and list the three risks most likely to matter, with a test for each.

tasks.title: Add token authentication, request schema validation and a rate limit to an API gateway route and test an invalid and a valid call
Write a small policy-as-code check that rejects infrastructure templates with public buckets or open SSH, and test it on five sample templates
Find and fix a broken object-level authorisation flaw in a seeded API so users cannot read other customers' records, and retest all cases

schedule.title: Law, residency and compliance
schedule.exercise: Write a half-page memo advising a Ghanaian fintech on where to host customer data, citing the relevant duties on registration and cross-border transfer.

tasks.title: Deploy a storage bucket and database in an approved region only, then add a policy denying creation of resources in any other region
Decide how to handle a data subject request and a cross-border transfer in a branching case and score the choices against a rubric
Map ten controls from an assurance framework to account configurations, collect evidence for each and list the gaps for audit preparation

schedule.title: Landing zones and capstone
schedule.exercise: Present your capstone design to a mock review board, defending each major control with the threat it answers.

tasks.title: Create separate accounts for production, development and logging, and attach a guardrail policy blocking disabling of central log delivery
Review a seeded workload against security pillar questions, score each area and rank five improvements by risk reduction per effort
Secure a mobile money style payment platform with network segmentation, encryption, least-privilege roles and detection rules, then test with failure injection
